--- title: "First 30 Days" subtitle: "What should WHOOP do when a member stops training? An end-to-end product analysis on public data." --- WHOOP is adding proactive features such as Coach check-ins. This project asks where a proactive message could matter most, and how WHOOP should test it: **when a member stops training**. It uses three public datasets, a dbt and DuckDB pipeline, and a pre-registered experiment readout, and ends in a one-page recommendation. ::: {.grid} ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4} ### 1. Lapses are common and recoverable The median member lapsed (14+ days without a workout) about **2\.0 times a year**, and **55%** were back within 14 days. Members returning from 12+ weeks away were the most fragile: only 36% came back. [Lapses & returns →](funnel.qmd) ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4} ### 2. Nudges work a little, then fade In a micro-randomized trial, a suggestion raised 30-minute steps by **\+16\.1%** (95% CI \+0\.5% to \+34\.2%), from \+55% on day 0 to \+4% by day 30. Specific walking prompts worked (\+23%); generic ones did not. [Experiment readout →](readout.qmd) ::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4} ### 3. The test is sized To detect a 2-point lift in members coming back, WHOOP would need about **19\,316 lapsed members**: roughly 9 weeks of enrolment from a 50,000-member eligible base. [30-day memo →](memo.qmd) ::: ::: ::: {.callout-tip} ## Recommendation Test one specific check-in on day 14 of a lapse, randomized per member, and judge it by whether members come back, **week by week**, with opt-outs and cancellations as guardrails. [Read the memo](memo.qmd). ::: ## How it is built ```{mermaid} flowchart LR A["Public data
Endomondo · HeartSteps · Google Play"] --> B["dbt staging
clean, typed, tested"] B --> C["dbt intermediate
gaps, lapses, decision points"] C --> D["dbt marts
facts and dimensions"] D --> E["Python analysis
survival, WCLS, power"] E --> F["This site
Quarto"] ``` - **Every analysis page reads only the marts**, and every number on them is computed at build time; none is typed in by hand. (The data audit deliberately reads the raw files.) - **The experiment plan was committed before any outcome was analyzed** (see the readout's commit history), and the readout replicates the published result. - **Leakage was found and fixed.** Comparing members with their whole history, future included, overstated the "slowdown before a lapse" signal; a past-only baseline replaced it ([details](funnel.qmd)). - **Not everything worked.** Keyword themes for app reviews were checked blind against hand labels, and only one rule held up, so the memo claims no theme shares. The [data audit](audit.qmd) explains what each dataset can and cannot support. Code, models and tests: [github.com/SudamshuRao/whoop-first-30-days](https://github.com/SudamshuRao/whoop-first-30-days)
